FROM name AS n
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON n.id = ci.person_id
JOIN title AS t ON ci.movie_id = t.id
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON t.id = mk.movie_id AND mk.keyword_id = (SELECT keyword_id FROM keyword WHERE keyword = 'character-name-in-title' LIMIT 1)

WHERE n.name LIKE '%B%'

AND ci.movie_id = mk.movie_id
AND ci.movie_id = (SELECT movie_id FROM movie_companies WHERE company_id = cn.id)
